Exact indexed Tabelog page says menu not edited, no phone and no customer reviews; plain curl is blocked. Recruitment describes the robatayaki/charcoal-grill and individually cooked kamameshi concept but does not publish named dishes, rice toppings, portion sizes or prices. Staff meals/wages are not public menu prices. No sister restaurant menu, unrelated restaurant image, logo or placeholder assigned to this branch. Link-only coverage is a genuine unpublished-menu gap after checking beyond the first source. Replenish actual launch dish/drink items and prices as soon as operator publishes them. Direct phone, booking route, final name, exact opening day and real property/food photographs remain unpublished. Date conflict: official branch and directory say late October 2026, October 10 Baitoru also late October, while Gourmetcaree says November and Townwork specifically mid-November. Do not silently resolve this into an exact day. Planned public label is Late 2026; November 30 is only an internal representative sorting date. Owner hours17:00–04:00(food03:00/drinks03:30) differ from recruitment work shifts18:00–05:00; work shifts are not established service hours.
